design_coverage.reason: No clustering or explicit variance-correction rule is reported for the selected portfolio fit.
The source identifies a multiple-regression event-study framework but not OLS/WLS/GLS or another underlying estimator.
The time-series equation includes an intercept but reports no fixed effects.

implementation_issues.description: The selected full-sample portfolio return is weighted using diagonal elements of a residual covariance matrix, but the transformation from those diagonal elements to constituent weights is not reported.
The paper calls the procedure a multiple-regression event study but does not identify the underlying estimator for the time-series equation.

The equation displays 3 event-date indicators; the table omits estimates for the intercept and market-return coefficient, and the paper does not report a standard-error or clustering rule for this selected full-sample fit.

The paper requires proxy statements with governance disclosures and insider-trading activity to construct the 489-firm final sample; the source does not define an insider-data source/window, and only archive-directory existence was checked.

review_notes: The full-sample portfolio fit has 251 daily time-series observations; Table 1 N=489 is constituent firms, not regression observations. The 1995 proxy and insider requirements belong to selected-sample membership. Shared SEC probes establish directory existence only; they do not establish files, content, access or coverage. Event dummies are fixed calendar-date indicators.
